title: Dihedral groups and geometric symmetry
section: Part B: Abstract Algebra ▷ Examples of Groups

question.text:
How many elements of order exactly 2 are in the symmetry group of a regular decagon?
(A) 5 (B) 9 (C) 10 (D) 11 (E) 20

solution.text:
5
There are ten reflections, each of order 2. Among rotations only the half-turn r has order
2. Hence there are eleven such elements.
